claims.claim: The seeded permissive profile produced 12 forbidden effects in 12 authored adversarial cases.
claims.not_established: Prevalence, novel vulnerability class, or a defect in any named product.

claims.claim: The guarded profile matched all 36 declared policy labels and preserved 12 positive effects.
claims.not_established: Universal correctness, production utility, or performance.

claims.claim: The partial profile retained 6 forbidden effects.
claims.not_established: Performance of an untested vendor mitigation.

claims.claim: A connector validating only an initial URL or DNS answer can contact a forbidden internal destination after a redirect or changed resolution alters the actual connection target.
claims.stage: original research hypothesis; only stated local subclaim evaluated
claims.not_established: Both endpoints are loopback fixtures; public DNS rebinding, IPv6, HTTPS certificate binding, proxies, metadata credential extraction, and a production connector were not tested. Resolution changes are adapter-controlled. The harness forbids destinations outside its two loopback addresses and port.
